basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old college student living in Ohio, currently pursuing a degree in computer science. I've recently returned to OSRS after a long hiatus and I'm trying to catch up with all the new updates. I've always enjoyed puzzles and challenges, which is why I spend a lot of my free time solving Rubik's Cubes and engaging in online games. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings, after classes and assignments. I'm single and enjoy the flexibility of student life, though it can get hectic during exam periods.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a decent understanding of Old School RuneScape from my teenage years, but I'm still catching up on recent updates and changes. I learned about Rubik's Cubes through various online communities and YouTube tutorials, which has helped me improve my solving skills.
